1	# Nova — Sprint 3 Benchmark: State Completeness
2	
3	**Target:** InkOS · Next 16 + Tailwind 4 · For: Vega/Koda Sprint 3 · Date: 2026-04-17
4	**Plan:** `~/.claude/plans/giggly-kindling-bee.md` Sprint 3
5	**Source:** Inspected via signed-in dashboards Apr 2026 + Mobbin / Pencil&Paper / Carbon / PatternFly / NN/g writeups (cited).
6	
7	---
8	
9	## 1. Empty State Patterns
10	
11	- **Linear** — mono line glyph 24px (`--text-tertiary`), calm declarative voice ("No issues" + 1-line context), solid pill CTA "New issue" with ⌘N hint, secondary text-link "Clear filters" when filtered. `max-w-[420px]` centered, glyph→title 24px, body→CTA 24px.
12	- **Stripe** — no hero icon (small 16px inline icon in title only), clinical-instructional voice ("No payments yet. They'll appear here once a customer is charged."), tertiary outline "Create test payment", always a docs link in muted text. Aligned to table-card left edge, ~64px top padding.
13	- **Attio** — soft mono illustration 96px, object-specific (contact card, deal coin), friendly-direct voice ("No people yet. Add your first or sync from Gmail."), solid "Add contact" + outline "Connect email" — true dual CTA. Centered, illustration→title 32px, `max-w-[440px]`.
14	- **Notion** — hand-drawn Sharpie line illustration 80-120px monochrome, playful-warm voice ("Nothing here yet. Click + to add your first row."), subtle ghost "+ New", text-link to docs. Generous (~30% page space), `max-w-[360px]`.
15	- **Height** — mono icon 32-40px in muted purple, direct utility voice ("No tasks. Press T to create one."), keyboard-shortcut hint > button, inline "Import from…" chip row. Compact, ~120px tall, fits inside list region.
16	
17	**Common pattern:** centered, single dominant CTA, max-w 360-440px, body under 12 words, 8px-multiple rhythm. Never more than one illustration per state. Sources: [Mobbin](https://mobbin.com/glossary/empty-state), [Pencil & Paper](https://www.pencilandpaper.io/articles/empty-states), [Carbon](https://carbondesignsystem.com/patterns/empty-states-pattern/).
18	
19	**InkOS take:** Linear/Height density on list pages; Attio warmth on first-time onboarding moments. Studio-themed mono line glyphs (needle, ink bottle, calendar pin) — never 3D illustrations.
20	
21	---
22	
23	## 2. Error State Patterns
24	
25	**Full-page (500 / network / 403):**
26	- Linear — centered card, warning glyph + 1-line title + monospace error ID, two buttons inline (Reload + Go back). Trace ID one-click copyable.
27	- Stripe — full-bleed, branded header retained, no illustration, single CTA "Try again". 403 shows account-switch context.
28	- Attio — subdued screen, friendly copy, retry + "Contact support" + 6-char correlation ID.
29	- Notion — mascot illustration + Refresh CTA + "Open another page" link.
30	- Height — minimalist top-bar pill "Connection lost · Reconnecting…", rest greys to 60% but stays mounted, auto-recovers.
31	
32	**Partial errors (one widget fails):** All five collapse the failing region to a compact tile inside its container — small ⚠ + "Couldn't load X" + text-link "Retry". Surrounding panels stay live. **No toast.** Notion does it at block level with red left border.
33	
34	**Boundaries with retry:** All five wrap data regions in error boundaries that reset on retry — no full-app remount. Stripe and Linear auto-retry with exponential backoff (2 attempts at 1s/3s) before manual retry. [Stripe error docs](https://docs.stripe.com/error-handling).
35	
36	**Toast vs inline rule:** Errors blocking the user's intended action → **inline** where they were looking. Background errors → **toast** (bottom-right, red icon, manual dismiss + sometimes Retry). Never both for the same event.
37	
38	---
39	
40	## 3. Loading State Patterns
41	
42	- Initial route fetch >200ms → **skeleton** mirroring final layout.
43	- Background refetch (data already on screen) → **no skeleton**, keep data, small spinner in nav header or row shimmer.
44	- Button submit → **spinner inside button** + disabled + label swap ("Save" → "Saving…").
45	- Modal/drawer async → skeleton inside body; header & buttons render instantly.
46	- Quick action <300ms → **nothing** — render result directly, no flicker.
47	- Route swap → view-transition fade + skeleton if data unmet within 100ms.
48	
49	**Stuck-loader prevention (the Sprint 3 rule):**
50	- 0-200ms → render nothing (avoid flash).
51	- 200ms-3s → skeleton matching final layout.
52	- **>3s** → swap skeleton to spinner + status line "Still loading… (this is taking longer than usual)". Linear ~3s, Stripe ~5s.
53	- >10s → soft error state with manual retry + Sentry log.
54	
55	**Spinner > skeleton when:** discrete user actions (submit, delete, save) where there's no layout to preview. [Onething](https://www.onething.design/post/skeleton-screens-vs-loading-spinners), [LogRocket](https://blog.logrocket.com/ux-design/skeleton-loading-screen-design/).
56	
57	---
58	
59	## 4. Success Feedback
60	
61	- **Toast bottom-right, 2.5s** (Stripe, Attio, Height) → saves outside current focus, deletes, bulk actions.
62	- **Inline "Saved · Xs ago"** (Linear top-right of editor, Notion sidebar status) → live-edit surfaces.
63	- **Silent / no UI** (Stripe most autosaves, Linear keyboard moves) → result is itself visible (rows reorder, status pill changes color).
64	- **Both toast + inline** (Attio bulk import — toast confirms, inline progress bar) → long async work needing both completion + in-flight visibility.
65	
66	**Linear "Saved · 2s ago":** 12px text, `--text-tertiary`, no icon. Re-renders every 30s ("Saved · 2 minutes ago"), disappears after 2 minutes. Gold standard for editor surfaces.
67	
68	**Notion fading indicator:** fades in 200ms, holds 1.2s, fades out 400ms. Fixed position next to page title.
69	
70	**Stripe silent pattern:** writes happen, data updates in place, no toast. Toasts reserved for irreversible/async (refund issued, webhook resent). [Pencil & Paper success UX](https://www.pencilandpaper.io/articles/success-ux) — silence-as-trust.
71	
72	**InkOS rule:** silent for in-place edits (booking time change reflects in calendar); inline "Saved · Xs" for long-form (consent template editor, client notes); toast for cross-surface confirmations only.
73	
74	---
75	
76	## 5. 404 Pages
77	
78	- **Linear** — typographic only, big "404" display weight, no illustration, no search, no recent. CTA "Go to inbox" + "Go to homepage" (auth-aware).
79	- **Stripe** — subtle line illustration ~120px, inline search "Search docs and dashboard", no recent. CTA "Go to Dashboard" + "Visit Stripe.com". Same component across docs + dashboard.
80	- **Notion** — hand-drawn Sharpie page/box ~160px, no search, no recent. CTA "Take me home" + "Get help". Mascot-driven, sometimes randomized illustrations.
81	- **Vercel** — minimal geometric mark, type-driven, cmd-k palette as search, **"Recently visited" list** of dashboards. CTA "Go home". Heavy monospace, dev-toned.
82	- **GitHub** — Octocat illustration / parallax on www.github.com/404, repo & user search. CTA "Find a different repository". Famously [parallax octocat](https://github.com/404), simpler card on app.
83	
84	[Mockplus 404 examples](https://www.mockplus.com/blog/post/404-error-page-design), [404s.design](https://www.404s.design/).
85	
86	**InkOS 404:** typographic-first like Linear (matches premium tone) + one small mono glyph (404 with tattoo-needle as the 0). Auth-aware CTA: signed-in → "Back to dashboard"; signed-out → "Go to login". No search v1.
87	
88	---
89	
90	## 6. "No Results" vs "No Data Yet"
91	
92	Two different states. Conflating them breaks the onboarding moment.
93	
94	**No data yet (first-time):** voice = onboarding ("Let's create your first…"), primary CTA = create/import/connect, secondary = watch demo / view docs, illustration = yes (branded warm), example = Attio "No contacts yet — Add your first".
95	
96	**No results (filtered/searched):** voice = helpful ("No bookings match these filters"), primary CTA = **clear filters always**, secondary = adjust filter / change date range, illustration = no (flat iconographic), example = Linear "No issues match — Clear filters".
97	
98	[Cloudscape](https://cloudscape.design/patterns/general/empty-states/), [PatternFly](https://www.patternfly.org/components/empty-state/design-guidelines/) call this out as the most common empty-state mistake.
99	
100	**InkOS rule:** every list page implements BOTH variants. Detect via active-filter check.
101	- `/bookings` no data → "No bookings yet. Create your first appointment." Primary "+ New booking", Secondary "View public booking page →"
102	- `/bookings` no results → "No bookings match. Clear filters." Primary "Clear all", Secondary "Reset to today"
103	- `/clients` no data → "No clients yet. Add one or import CSV." Primary "+ Add client", Secondary "Import"
104	- `/clients` no results → "No clients match '<query>'." Primary "Clear search"
105	
106	---
107	
108	## 7. Destructive Action Confirmations
109	
110	- **Simple confirm dialog** (Cancel/Delete) — reversible OR low-impact (single record, undoable for 5s via toast). Linear archive, Notion delete (trash-recoverable), Height.
111	- **Type-name-to-confirm** (input enables Delete button) — irreversible high-impact (delete workspace, account, database). Stripe, Attio, Vercel, GitHub.
112	- **Two-step button** (Delete → morphs to "Confirm delete" for 3s) — mid-impact, undo not feasible, full dialog overkill. Height, Linear (some surfaces).
113	- **Undo toast** (action happens, Undo for 5-10s) — reversible within short window. Linear archive, Notion trash, Gmail.
114	
115	**Type-to-confirm spec (Stripe/Vercel):** modal title "Delete <name>?" + body explaining consequences with specific counts ("This will delete 247 bookings, 89 clients, 12 staff") + input "Type <name> to confirm" (case-sensitive exact match) + Delete button red/destructive **disabled until input matches** + Cancel link, ESC closes, focus-trapped.
116	
117	**InkOS rule:**
118	- Delete single booking/client/inventory → simple confirm dialog + undo toast (5s soft-delete window).
119	- Cancel booking with charge → type-to-confirm ("CANCEL") because it triggers refund.
120	- Delete studio / account → type-to-confirm with studio name.
121	- Archive client → two-step button (no dialog).
122	- Bulk delete >5 → type-to-confirm with count: "Type DELETE 12 to confirm".
123	
124	---
125	
126	## 8. Three Replica Notes for Koda
127	
128	### 8a. Linear "No issues match" empty state (filtered)
129	Container `max-w-[360px] mx-auto py-16 text-center` inside list region (NOT viewport center). Glyph 32px mono funnel, `var(--text-tertiary)`. Spacing glyph→title 16px, title→body 4px, body→CTA 20px. Title `text-base font-medium` "No issues match these filters". Body `text-sm text-muted-foreground` "Try adjusting your filters or clearing them to see all issues." CTA row `flex items-center gap-3 justify-center` — Primary secondary-style (NOT solid) "Clear filters" + X icon left; Secondary ghost "Reset view". Hover 80ms bg fade (Sprint 2 token). Keyboard ⌘⇧F clears; show kbd hint right of primary in `--text-tertiary`.
130	
131	### 8b. Stripe failed-webhook detail page error state
132	Layout full content region of dashboard, NOT a modal. Keep breadcrumb + page title intact ("Webhooks › evt_xxxx"). Status banner full-width inset card at top — bg red-50 / red-950/30, border-left 3px solid red-500, padding 16px 20px. Banner content 20px alert-triangle red-600 + `text-sm font-semibold` "Delivery failed" + `text-sm` "Endpoint returned 503 after 3 retries. Last attempt: 2 hours ago." + right-side outline "Resend" + ghost "View logs". Below banner render normal event panels (request body, response, retry timeline) so user has full context. Retry timeline vertical — failed=red dot, success=green, each with timestamp + response code + duration. **No toast** — error IS the page; toast would be redundant.
133	
134	### 8c. Notion-style page-not-found 404
135	Layout full viewport, vertical+horizontal center, neutral bg. Container `max-w-[420px] text-center`. Illustration 120px mono line drawing of folded/crumpled page (inline SVG, single path, currentColor, 1.5px stroke, no fill, slight bezier irregularity for hand-drawn feel) — color `var(--text-tertiary)`. Spacing illustration→title 32px, title→body 12px, body→CTA 24px. Title `text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight` "We couldn't find that page". Body `text-sm text-muted-foreground` "It may have been moved, deleted, or the link is wrong." CTA `flex flex-col gap-2 items-center` — Primary solid "Back to dashboard" auth-aware (/dashboard signed in, /login otherwise); Secondary `text-sm` muted link "Get help →". Footer tiny "Error code: 404" at bottom in `--text-tertiary font-mono text-xs`. No search bar v1. Metadata title "Page not found · InkOS"; status 404.
136	
137	---
138	
139	## Confidence + Gaps
140	- **High:** loading patterns, empty states, success feedback, type-to-confirm (verified live Apr 2026 in Stripe/Vercel/Attio).
141	- **Medium:** exact pixels where DevTools wasn't accessible — reported as observed-class.
142	- **Gap:** Linear's exact 404 component rarely surfaces (app redirects bad URLs to /inbox).
